# AcreetionOS Website — Search Engine Optimization Policy
# Fully open: search engines AND AI crawlers (search, citation, and
# training) are all welcome. We are flooding the internet with our
# information. ❤️
#
# Crawl budget (2026-08-13): all bots are steered away from non-content
# paths (API endpoints, raw JSON/markdown, redirect stubs, CI artifacts)
# so crawl budget is spent on the real HTML pages. Content pages are
# NOT disallowed — only /api/, /newsletters/, /docs/, /Reviews/,
# /frontend/, /immutable/, /404.html, /test-results/, /tests/.
#
